## Cartwheels Programs

 

[Program Registration](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php) [Schedule at a glance](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/forms/Term_2_Schedule_2026-27.pdf)

 

 

[Tiny Gym (1 and walking to 3 years) 45 minutes Your child's first gym class! This class is for our youngest gymnasts with their parent/caregiver. It focuses on both sensory and gross motor development, co-ordination, balance, strength, flexibility, social skills, and fun!! **The 1-year old participants are strongly recommended to be fully independently walking before the term begins. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

 

[Rock n' Roll with Miss Kelly (0+ years) 45 minutes This class offers a safe environment for your child to grow physically, cognitively, and socially through music and movement. In this class we will use sensory rich props and musical instruments as we enjoy interactive playtime through song, dance, and physical literacy. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term. Music Instructor - Platinum Music Instruction - Gold](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

 

[Tumble & Learn (2y 11m to 4 years) 2 hours Preschool & Kindergarten readiness program at Cartwheels. Tumble n’ Learn will focus on gross and fine motor development; sensory skills; strength, coordination, balance, and flexibility; independence and social skills. This two-hour drop-off program will include 45-minutes of a structured gymnastics class, music class, learning activity, group games, and a healthy snack break (nut/peanut free snack brought weekly by participants). This program allows participants to register for longer than one term length for increased development and continuity for the children Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

 

[Mini Gym (3/3½ - 4 years) 45 minutes Our eligibility rule for Mini Gym is that they have just participated in our Tiny Gym program (in the term prior to their move to Mini Gym) AND are showing signs of readiness to participate without a parent, OR are already 3 ½ when registering. If your child is new to Cartwheels, OR is a returning member with a break between participating in our terms, and they are not yet three years + six months prior to the term start date, they must register into Tiny Gym. This is to learn the routine, expectations, and structure of our program. No exceptions due to the demand & limited Mini Gym spots. **Participants must also be fully toilet trained (no pull-ups) to register into Mini Gym. If you choose to proceed with registration past the pop-up informing you of these requirements, you will be contacted to move to Tiny Gym or refund/credit your registration until they are eligible. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

 

[Kindergym (4-6 years) 55 minutes A fast paced class geared to channel this age group's energy in a positive direction. This class provides opportunities to build social skills, self-confidence, and develop physical and motor attributes including: flexibility, strength, power, and endurance as well as balance and spatial orientation. All this in a gymnastics setting! Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

 

[JR Gym (6-8 years) 55 minutes This recreational program is for those wanting to experience the fun and thrill of gymnastics! The program promotes physical fitness and allows children to achieve new skills by focusing on their strengths and encouraging development of their weaker areas. They work on an achievement program consisting of a system of progressive skills that each child works on at their own pace. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

 

[SR Gym (8-10 years) 55 minutes This recreational program is for those wanting to experience the fun and thrill of gymnastics! The program promotes physical fitness and allows children to achieve new skills by focusing on their strengths and encouraging development of their weaker areas. They work on an achievement program consisting of a system of progressive skills that each child works on at their own pace. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

 

[Preteen/Teen Gym (ages 10+) 60 minutes This recreational program is for those over age 10 wanting to experience the fun and thrill of gymnastics! The program promotes physical fitness and allows children to achieve new skills by focusing on their strengths and encouraging development of their weaker areas. They work on an achievement program consisting of a system of progressive skills that each child works on at their own pace. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

 

[Cartwheels Plus Programming (5 years to teen) 55 minutes An invitation only advanced class open to those that need to be challenged at a higher level and can handle being taught at a faster rate than our other programming. This class will focus on strength and flexibility training as well as more advanced skills. Participants must be invited from Cartwheels programming and registration requires a code to unlock the program. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

Cartwheels Gym Centre in Georgetown, Ontario has a parent-and-tot class that fits a toddler. I read this off their own programs page, and I haven't stood in the building.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Tiny Gym, Cartwheels Gym Centre",
      "name_evidence": "Tiny Gym (1 and walking to 3 years) 45 minutes Your child's first gym class! This class is for our youngest gymnasts with their parent/caregiver.",
      "age_fit": "1 and walking to 3 years",
      "age_evidence": "Tiny Gym (1 and walking to 3 years)",
      "source_name": "Cartwheels Gym Centre",
      "source_url": "https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/programs.php"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Class:** Tiny Gym runs 45 minutes with a parent or caregiver. Their page says one-year-olds are strongly recommended to be walking independently before the term begins.
- **Days and times:** The page links a "Term 2 Schedule 2026-27" PDF, which I could not open. I did not read any day or time for Tiny Gym, so none is listed.
- **Price:** Their site says availability and pricing are only shown after logging into their registration website. Prices are not on the main site because term lengths vary.
- **Registration:** The only registration date I saw was for Term 1/Fall, which opened Wednesday, July 22, 2026 at 8:00am online. That has already passed. I did not find a registration date for the next term.
- **Name:** I took "Cartwheel Gym" to mean Cartwheels Gym Centre at 12 Armstrong Ave. I did not use Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre, which is a different gym with its own Parent and Tot class.
